# A2UI v1.0's JSON Schemas

Copied byte for byte from [a2ui-project/a2ui](https://github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui/tree/5f6d26c48a5c61bf845cf1ef2a02a47e31e8d9ba/specification/v1_0/json) at commit `5f6d26c48a5c61bf845cf1ef2a02a47e31e8d9ba` (2026-11-13), Apache-2.0. `test/a2ui.test.mts` checks these hashes, then validates Ouro HX's catalogs against `catalog_definition.json` and every conformance case's messages against `agent_to_renderer.json`, with `catalog.json` resolved to our catalog. Never edit them; to move to a newer A2UI, copy the new files and update the hashes here and in the test.
